description: Retrieval-verification dataset for the pools.fun launchpad namespace on Robinhood Chain (4663). Two rows per live tool, one blind and one protocol-aware, written from the manifests and the navigation entry only, so the query wording is independent of the retrieval index's own discovery text. Blind rows describe the outcome a user wants without naming the launchpad; protocol-aware rows name pools.fun. Every expectation is the exact full dotted toolId.

queries.query: list tokens that launched on the Robinhood Chain launchpad in the last six hours, newest first
screen new launchpad tokens with a market cap between 50k and 500k and at least 200 trades in the last day
browse pools.fun launches ranked by one hour volume so I can see what is actually trading right now
the user said the ticker is SUSHICAT, get me the contract address of that launchpad token
resolve a token by name on pools.fun and show every copycat sharing that symbol
full detail on one launchpad token: which pool is its real pool, who deployed it, the fee split and its decimals
who earns the creator fees on the pools.fun token at 0x0ab8d01664d4bb625705f9f3c595a8a19b3dcfb0 and how is the 1 percent split
hourly open high low close and volume history for a launchpad token on Robinhood Chain, last 24 bars
chart a pools.fun token in 15 minute candles so I can see how it has traded since it opened
which tokens has my own wallet deployed on this launchpad, I need the address of the coin I made
review my own pools.fun launches and show what each one currently has waiting to be claimed
collect the creator fees my launched token has accrued in the locker and pay them out to my wallet
simulate first: how much would claiming the creator fees on my pools.fun token pay in both assets before I sign
estimate what deploying a new token on the Robinhood Chain launchpad would cost me, including a 0.05 ETH first buy
price a pools.fun launch before I commit to it, with the current deployment fee broken out
I am not allowed to spend here, so ask the user to confirm the new token deployment in the app's own form
open the pools.fun launch form prefilled with the proposed name, ticker and 0.01 ETH prebuy and wait for the user to submit it
deploy the token now on Robinhood Chain: name Moon Cat, ticker MCAT, paired against ETH, 0.02 ETH prebuy, using the staged image
sign and broadcast my coin's launch on pools.fun for real against USDG
which tokenised stocks can a new coin be paired with when it is created on the Robinhood Chain launchpad
list the pools.fun launch pairs and say which of them need a freshly signed price at launch
what have I earned so far just by holding this coin that shares its trading fees with holders
read the fees-to-holders state for this pools.fun token and tell me what the distributor owes my wallet
collect the fees I have earned just by holding this coin and put them in my wallet
claim my holder rewards on this pools.fun token, but simulate what it would pay first
the rewards on this coin have stalled, push its collected fees out to everyone holding it
trigger the permissionless reward distribution on this pools.fun token so holders start earning
